label: Business Premium
what_it_is: The highest published website package for richer commerce or advanced site needs.
best_for: Sites that need the published Premium inclusions
Organisations whose requirements clearly exceed Smart
good_when: Commerce depth or advanced site features are in the live Premium list
They understand the cost and need the extras
not_good_when: A brochure or mid-tier site would solve it
They actually need a custom business system — say so and route correctly
expert_recommendation: Recommend Premium only when requirements justify it; otherwise protect the client from overbuying.
upsell_only_when: Never as a default. Only when Smart cannot cover the stated need.
important_tradeoff: More features and cost. Willing to recommend against Premium when Basic/Smart fits.
